name: Margin Call Result 3
definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts per margin type and optionaly the default fund amount (only for CCP).

DefaultFundAmount.name: Default Fund Amount
DefaultFundAmount.definition: Specifies the total amount required by the clearing member to participate to the default fund.

MarginCallResult.name: Margin Call Result
MarginCallResult.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin and the segregated independent amount or the segregated independent amount only or the total margin call amount only.
